FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION

The two control units for driver side door M66 and passenger side door M67 are supplied - by the window function - at pin 8 of connector D via two lines protected by fuses F78 and F80 of the boot compartment fuse box B45.

Pin 19 connector B and 7 of connector D of M66 and M67 are earthed. Control units M66 and M67 are connected via a CAN line to one another and to Body Computer M1.

Unit H44 contains the driver and passenger side window controls:: dedicated analogue signals are sent to pins 31 and 32 of connector A of M66 (pin 33 supplies a reference earth).. Similarly, the control at the passenger front door H50 sends a special analogue signal to the control unit M67 pin 32 (pin 33 provides the reference earth).

Control unit M66 operates the motor N60 (driver's side) directly - pins 9 and 10 of connector D - and via control unit M67 - pins 9 and 10 of connector D - motor N61 (passenger side).

Pins 2 and 5 of connector C of M66 and M67 receive signals from the anticrush sensors located in motor N60 or N61; pins 11 and 10 of connector B of M66 and M67 supply a power supply and reference earth to the sensors.

The two control units are connected to the instrument panel E50 via the CAN line to manage the signal if there is a failure in the anti-crush safety sensors.
